content:
1840 & Company is a global talent and outsourcing firm. The company is known to  connect skilled professionals with leading businesses, and it is more focused in the U.S. market. The company focuses on remote workforce solutions. It provides recruitment and operational support that allows an organization to build distributed teams and gives professionals access to meaningful international career opportunities. 1840 and Company is looking to scale efficiently as it has combined workforce expertise with a remote-first approach.

How 1840 & Company Works

1840 & Company is a bridge that connects global talent and companies who want long-term workforce solutions. Its model is something that is very unique as it is built around sourcing and managing remote professionals. Moreover, it makes sure both clients and talent receive continuous support.

Its service framework covers:

  • Talent sourcing and recruitment
  • Workforce management and support
  • Outsourcing and operational services
  • Global remote collaboration

This approach is very popular as it allows the organizations to:

  • Build distributed teams across multiple regions
  • The company can feel the reduced hiring and operational complexities
  • Access specialized skills globally
  • Companies are able to maintain productivity with remote infrastructure

Core Capabilities

Global Talent Acquisition

1840  and Company works closely to identify and recruit skilled professionals from diverse regions

Remote Workforce Management

They support the distributed teams with structured systems and communication

Outsourcing Solutions

The company is popular because it is known to provide operational efficiency through managed services

Employer Support Systems

The platform is very employer-friendly as it allows the smooth onboarding, payroll, and compliance

Career Enablement

Overall, the organisation allows professionals to secure long-term, growth-oriented roles

What Makes 1840 & Company Stand Out?

• 1840 and Company is very focused on providing long-term partnerships
• It offers a strong focus on remote work culture and global collaboration
• The company offers an opportunity to work with established U.S.-based companies
• Commitment to employee well-being and career progression
• In the last few years, the company has emerged as a growing player in outsourcing and recruitment services

Key Services

• Recruitment & Talent Placement – The advanced system allows pairing of companies with qualified remote professionals
• Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) – It manages the essential business functions very efficiently
• Remote Staffing Solutions – 1840 & Company is known to build and support global teams
• Workforce Operations – It handles compliance and performance support
• Back Office & Customer Support – Many organization who have worked with 1840 & Company have seen enhanced operational workflows

Advanced Capabilities

• Global Talent Cloud – The company has an advanced network of professionals ready for remote opportunities
• Scalable Hiring Solutions – Businesses get quality support at different growth stages
• Continuous Upskilling – Many employees are enjoying improved skills and advanced careers at the platform.
• Remote Work Infrastructure – 1840 & Company is designed such that for seamless global collaboration
• Culture-Driven Engagement – It creates a well-connected and motivated remote workforce

Who Should Work with 1840 & Company?

Businesses

  • 1840 & Company is best suited for companies that are looking to hire remote talent globally
    • Organizations that are looking to reduce operational costs
    • Teams that need scalable workforce solutions can also get services from 1840 and company.

Professionals

  • Individuals who want remote roles with international companies
    • Professional prefers this platform for long-term career growth, not freelance gigs
    • 1840 & Company offers employees a flexible, location-independent work

Best-Fit Industries

• Information Technology – Development, support, and digital services
• Healthcare – Administrative and operational support roles
• Finance & Accounting – Back-office and financial services
• Retail & E-commerce – Customer service and operations
• Telecommunications – Support and technical roles
• Logistics & Supply Chain – Coordination and operational management
• Professional Services – Administrative and business support

Key Use Cases

  • Remote Hiring – Building distributed teams across countries
  • Workforce Expansion – Scaling operations without physical offices
  • Outsourced Operations – Managing non-core business functions
  • Career Advancement – Helping professionals access global opportunities
  • Business Efficiency – Streamlining processes through remote support

Pros

  • Access to global job opportunities
    • Strong support system for remote professionals
    • Scalable solutions for businesses
    • Focus on long-term employment relationships
    • Emphasis on employee well-being and growth

Considerations

  • Primarily focused on remote work environments
    • May not suit companies needing on-site teams
    • Competitive selection process for top roles
    • Dependence on digital communication and time zone coordination

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • MarketJoy – Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Toptal – This platform offers a premium freelance talent platform
  • Upwork – Upwork has a very large marketplace for freelance services
  • Remote – It allows for remote hiring and compliance solutions
  • Deel – The platform is very popular for international hiring and payroll services
  • Andela – Andela is more focused on tech talent sourcing

Takeaway

1840 & Company has come forward as a quality life, and it has positioned itself as more than just a staffing provider. The platform wants to serve as a long-term partner for both businesses and professionals who are looking for the global remote work landscape. It combines  recruitment expertise with a people-first philosophy, and overall, 1840 & Company allows companies to scale efficiently. It also helps individuals build sustainable careers that reward them from anywhere in the world.
